meta.title: Yanyan Toolkit
meta.description: One bundle with five independently toggleable plugins: Plugin Update (checks local and registry plugin versions, updates them one by one), Session Hub (three-pane layout: session / workspace / tags / recycle bin, batch archive & delete, move-in & restore, side-car ledger that never touches native sessions), Subagent Management (session header tab, permanent per-row delete with log root-cause removal + in-memory projection fix, clean all idle, and idle-time auto-cleanup), Icon Generator (center-crops an uploaded image and generates an icon.svg fitted for the plugin list artwork slot), and Find the Right Plugin (ranks the plugin ecosystem by relevance and recommends the best match). Install this one package to get all five.
